patterns.name: Humaan — staged culture photography and a large purpose statement

patterns.name: Linear — company thesis beside an editorial narrative

patterns.name: Stripe — illustrated company manifesto in a narrow reading column
patterns.fit: An established organization explaining a substantive mission or investment philosophy to partners, recruits and informed buyers.

patterns.name: Humaan — staggered portrait grid with persistent role labels
patterns.fit: A sizable service team with comparable photos and clear individual roles.

patterns.name: Team Design — text directory with inline portrait biographies
patterns.fit: A consultancy whose individual backgrounds matter but whose full biographies would overwhelm an always-expanded grid.

patterns.name: Lime Studio — complementary founders with cinematic portraits
patterns.fit: A small partnership where customers actually work with both named principals.

patterns.name: Framer — large sitemap with a separate utility strip
patterns.fit: A mature product or platform with many genuinely useful destinations.

patterns.name: Mailchimp — warm resource directory and brand-family utility layer
patterns.fit: A product with a real resource ecosystem, mobile apps and a broader company family.

patterns.name: Locomotive — ruled navigation and a typographic contact signature

patterns.name: Attio — testimonial-backed sales inquiry

patterns.name: Linear — intent-routing contact cards

patterns.name: Studio Freight — editorial project brief form

patterns.name: Stripe — staged sales-routing form
patterns.fit: A genuine multi-stage inquiry where early answers route the visitor to a relevant next step.

patterns.name: Unseen Studio — scene-led direct contact
patterns.fit: A creative practice selling distinctive visual judgment and working through direct conversations rather than structured qualification.

patterns.name: KUBE Saint-Tropez — map and direct contact
patterns.fit: A place-based business where finding the location and contacting staff are the main tasks.

patterns.name: Studio Freight — inquiry-routing FAQ

patterns.name: KUBE Saint-Tropez — editorial practical FAQ
patterns.fit: Practical access, appointment, arrival, and service questions near a contact or booking decision.

patterns.name: Raycast Pro — centered dark accordion
patterns.fit: A product or subscription page with a handful of real buying objections and moderate answer lengths.

patterns.name: Framer — always-visible pricing answers
patterns.fit: A manageable set of concise pricing explanations that should remain visible together.

patterns.name: Switchyards — topic-linked document FAQ

patterns.name: TypeSafe AI — terminal-inspired technical accordion

patterns.name: KUBE Saint-Tropez — restrained reservation close

patterns.name: Switchyards — membership offer and oversized join action

patterns.name: Linear — self-service and sales closing CTA
patterns.fit: A product with genuinely useful self-service and assisted-sales entry points.

patterns.name: Framer — product-start CTA with a mobile alternative
patterns.fit: A product whose first meaningful action can be initiated in a small inline interaction.

patterns.name: Front — branded demo panel with people imagery
patterns.fit: An assisted-sale offer that needs a distinctive final invitation and credible human context.

patterns.name: charity: water — illustrated newsletter signup
patterns.fit: An organization with a meaningful email program and enough reason for visitors to stay connected.

patterns.name: Linear — layered product demo with a selectable visual state

patterns.name: Raycast — task-language feature index beside a focused preview
patterns.fit: A product with many short, recognizable tasks and useful visual demonstrations for a few of them.

patterns.name: Apple — synchronized product views with labeled color swatches

patterns.name: Raycast — compact capability matrix with included and paid states
patterns.fit: A small number of alternatives sharing a meaningful set of comparable capabilities.

patterns.name: Framer — decision-factor table with explicit choice guidance

patterns.name: Opendoor — parallel service timelines focused on the customer milestone

patterns.name: Linear — integrations explained as input-to-work workflows

patterns.name: Attio — categorized app catalog with contextual command search

patterns.name: Ramp / NetSuite — capability illustrations with app and support context

patterns.name: Raycast — atmospheric product hero

patterns.name: KUBE Saint-Tropez — cinematic destination hero

patterns.name: Apple MacBook Air — product sculpture hero
patterns.fit: A physical product with a recognizable silhouette, meaningful material/detail, and excellent rendering or photography.

patterns.name: Raycast Pro — illustrated feature bento

patterns.name: KUBE Saint-Tropez — photographic room bento

patterns.name: Attio — workflow demonstration bento

patterns.name: Linear — restrained four-tier comparison
patterns.fit: A product with meaningful feature and seat limits across three or four plans.

patterns.name: Resend — usage-guided plan recommendation

patterns.name: Lemon Squeezy — parallel billing models in pastel panels

patterns.name: Designjoy — tangible membership beside one subscription

patterns.name: Linear — asymmetric quotes linked to customer stories

patterns.name: Raycast — profile selector with specific usage endorsements

patterns.name: Designjoy — two editorial endorsements without cards

patterns.name: Opendoor — family stories with inline video and location

patterns.name: Designjoy — three illustrated service steps
patterns.fit: A simple recurring service where the visitor needs to understand what to request and receive.

patterns.name: Framer — product demonstration with three stage summaries
patterns.fit: A visual software workflow with a useful demonstration and three meaningful phases.

patterns.name: Opendoor — selectable steps with matching service visuals
patterns.fit: A multi-stage service with distinct artifacts or actions at each step.

patterns.name: Lime Studio — editorial numbered process with proof and next action
patterns.fit: A consultative service with a clear first conversation, delivery stage and client outcome.

patterns.name: Instrument — service rows with directly relevant project proof

patterns.name: Humaan — six capability groups in a quiet type-led matrix

patterns.name: ustwo — engagement offers with activities, outcomes and proof

patterns.name: Instrument — filterable work grid with separate display modes

patterns.name: Humaan — featured project followed by paired visual cards
patterns.fit: A curated portfolio with one strong lead project and enough distinctive finished work to support varied crops.

patterns.name: Locomotive — project index with expandable rich previews

patterns.name: Instrument / Oura — rationale, paired deliverables and a time-bounded impact block
patterns.fit: A substantial redesign with documented research, finished artifacts and credible post-launch evidence.
